Folks —

Attached is the one-page attestation template filled and signed by InfoSec (see attestation-template.pdf). Summary points added inline:

- Encrypt-only enforcement: KMS key policies are scoped to allow Encrypt/GenerateDataKey only for subprocessor IAM roles; no kms:Decrypt is permitted for those roles. Key usage is audited and cross-account access is limited via condition-based policies (aws:PrincipalArn + aws:SourceVpc).
- Telemetry vendors (metrics-telemetry-prod): compensating controls — (1) egress limited via AWS NACLs and VPC endpoints; (2) ephemeral credentials rotated every 6 hours via our credential broker; (3) strict RBAC limiting data selectors to aggregated, non-identifying metrics.
- Anomaly-detector-3p: compensating controls — (1) no raw payload access, only hashed feature vectors; (2) inbound-only network routes; (3) annual penetration testing and yearly access recertification.

I’ve uploaded the signed attestation to DocuSign (link shared above) and attached the PDF to this thread for procurement. Let me know if you need additional signature blocks for legal.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Information Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
